channel.title: Cyber Threat Wall — Latest Movers
channel.description: Actively exploited vulnerabilities rising fastest in Cyber Threat Wall rankings.

item.title: CVE-2026-86950 — Apple Multiple Products
item.description: Threat Signal 68. Apple iOS, macOS, and iPadOS contain an out-of-bounds write vulnerability in CoreGraphics that may lead to arbitrary code execution.

item.title: CVE-2026-5430 — WSO2 Multiple Products
item.description: Threat Signal 67. WSO2 API Control Plane, API Manager, Traffic Manager & Universal Gateway contain a path traversal vulnerability that could allow for unrestricted file upload and lead to remote code execution.

item.title: CVE-2026-84869 — ConnectWise ScreenConnect
item.description: Threat Signal 67. ConnectWise ScreenConnect contains both an improper privilege management and missing authorization vulnerability that may allow an attacker to transfer and execute files through an active remote session without authorization or host confirmation.

item.title: CVE-2026-42016 — JFrog Artifactory
item.description: Threat Signal 67. JFrog Artifactory contains an incorrect authorization vulnerability that leads to a privilege escalation attack due to a validation check of the token signature/issuer and not the token’s scope.

item.title: CVE-2026-42018 — JFrog Artifactory
item.description: Threat Signal 64. JFrog Artifactory contains an improper authentication vulnerability that could return an internal anonymous-user token to an unauthenticated caller when anonymous access is disabled, potentially exposing sensitive resources.

item.title: CVE-2026-85880 — Microsoft Windows
item.description: Threat Signal 64. Microsoft Windows Advanced Local Procedure Call contains a heap-based buffer overflow vulnerability that allows an attacker to elevate privileges locally.

item.title: CVE-2026-60004 — Gitea Gitea
item.description: Threat Signal 69. Gitea contains a code injection vulnerability that allows an attacker with repository write access to send a malicious patch to the diffpatch API endpoint to plant an executable Git hook and run shell commands as the Gitea service account.

item.title: CVE-2026-39987 — Marimo Marimo
item.description: Threat Signal 69. Marimo contains an pre-authorization remote code execution vulnerability, allowing an unauthenticated attacked to shell access and execute arbitrary system commands.

item.title: CVE-2009-0238 — Microsoft Office
item.description: Threat Signal 69. Microsoft Office Excel contains a remote code execution vulnerability that could allow an attacker to take complete control of an affected system if a user opens a specially crafted Excel file that includes a malformed object.

item.title: CVE-2025-60710 — Microsoft Windows
item.description: Threat Signal 69. Microsoft Windows contains a link following vulnerability that allows for privilege escalation

item.title: CVE-2025-21042 — Samsung Mobile Devices
item.description: Threat Signal 69. Samsung mobile devices contain an out-of-bounds write vulnerability in libimagecodec.quram.so. This vulnerability could allow remote attackers to execute arbitrary code.

item.title: CVE-2021-43226 — Microsoft Windows
item.description: Threat Signal 69. Microsoft Windows Common Log File System Driver contains a privilege escalation vulnerability that could allow a local, privileged attacker to bypass certain security mechanisms.

item.title: CVE-2020-25079 — D-Link DCS-2530L and DCS-2670L Devices
item.description: Threat Signal 69. D-Link DCS-2530L and DCS-2670L devices contains a command injection vulnerability in the cgi-bin/ddns_enc.cgi. The impacted products could be end-of-life (EoL) and/or end-of-service (EoS). Users should discontinue product utilization.

item.title: CVE-2023-44221 — SonicWall SMA100 Appliances
item.description: Threat Signal 69. SonicWall SMA100 appliances contain an OS command injection vulnerability in the SSL-VPN management interface that allows a remote, authenticated attacker with administrative privilege to inject arbitrary commands as a 'nobody' user.

item.title: CVE-2025-29824 — Microsoft Windows
item.description: Threat Signal 69. Microsoft Windows Common Log File System (CLFS) Driver contains a use-after-free vulnerability that allows an authorized attacker to elevate privileges locally.

item.title: CVE-2020-11023 — JQuery JQuery
item.description: Threat Signal 69. JQuery contains a persistent cross-site scripting (XSS) vulnerability. When passing maliciously formed, untrusted input enclosed in HTML tags, JQuery's DOM manipulators can execute untrusted code in the context of the user's browser.

item.title: CVE-2024-43572 — Microsoft Windows
item.description: Threat Signal 69. Microsoft Windows Management Console contains unspecified vulnerability that allows for remote code execution.

item.title: CVE-2024-43461 — Microsoft Windows
item.description: Threat Signal 69. Microsoft Windows MSHTML Platform contains a user interface (UI) misrepresentation of critical information vulnerability that allows an attacker to spoof a web page. This vulnerability was exploited in conjunction with CVE-2024-38112.

item.title: CVE-2024-37085 — VMware ESXi
item.description: Threat Signal 69. VMware ESXi contains an authentication bypass vulnerability. A malicious actor with sufficient Active Directory (AD) permissions can gain full access to an ESXi host that was previously configured to use AD for user management by re-creating the configured AD group ('ESXi Admins' by default) after it was deleted from AD.

item.title: CVE-2023-36844 — Juniper Junos OS
item.description: Threat Signal 69. Juniper Junos OS on EX Series contains a PHP external variable modification vulnerability that allows an unauthenticated, network-based attacker to control certain, important environment variables. Using a crafted request an attacker is able to modify certain PHP environment variables, leading to partial loss of integrity, which may allow chaining to other vulnerabilities.

item.title: CVE-2023-41763 — Microsoft Skype for Business
item.description: Threat Signal 69. Microsoft Skype for Business contains an unspecified vulnerability that allows for privilege escalation.

item.title: CVE-2021-27876 — Veritas Backup Exec Agent
item.description: Threat Signal 69. Veritas Backup Exec (BE) Agent contains a file access vulnerability that could allow an attacker to specially craft input parameters on a data management protocol command to access files on the BE Agent machine.

item.title: CVE-2020-5741 — Plex Media Server
item.description: Threat Signal 69. Plex Media Server contains a remote code execution vulnerability that allows an attacker with access to the server administrator's Plex account to upload a malicious file via the Camera Upload feature and have the media server execute it.

item.title: CVE-2018-18809 — TIBCO JasperReports
item.description: Threat Signal 69. TIBCO JasperReports Library contains a directory-traversal vulnerability that may allow web server users to access contents of the host system.

item.title: CVE-2022-26500 — Veeam Backup & Replication
item.description: Threat Signal 69. The Veeam Distribution Service in the Backup & Replication application allows unauthenticated users to access internal API functions. A remote attacker can send input to the internal API which may lead to uploading and executing of malicious code.

item.title: CVE-2020-3153 — Cisco AnyConnect Secure
item.description: Threat Signal 69. Cisco AnyConnect Secure Mobility Client for Windows allows for incorrect handling of directory paths. An attacker with valid credentials on Windows would be able to copy malicious files to arbitrary locations with system level privileges. This could include DLL pre-loading, DLL hijacking, and other related attacks.

item.title: CVE-2020-36193 — PEAR Archive_Tar
item.description: Threat Signal 69. PEAR Archive_Tar Tar.php allows write operations with directory traversal due to inadequate checking of symbolic links. PEAR stands for PHP Extension and Application Repository and it is an open-source framework and distribution system for reusable PHP components with known usage in third-party products such as Drupal Core and Red Hat Linux.

item.title: CVE-2017-6862 — NETGEAR Multiple Devices
item.description: Threat Signal 69. Multiple NETGEAR devices contain a buffer overflow vulnerability that allows for authentication bypass and remote code execution.

item.title: CVE-2011-0609 — Adobe Flash Player
item.description: Threat Signal 69. Adobe Flash Player contains an unspecified vulnerability that allows remote attackers to execute code or cause denial-of-service (DoS).

item.title: CVE-2009-0563 — Microsoft Office
item.description: Threat Signal 69. Microsoft Office contains a buffer overflow vulnerability that allows remote attackers to execute code via a Word document with a crafted tag containing an invalid length field.

item.title: CVE-2016-0984 — Adobe Flash Player and AIR
item.description: Threat Signal 69. Use-after-free vulnerability in Adobe Flash Player and Adobe AIR allows attackers to execute code.

item.title: CVE-2015-2419 — Microsoft Internet Explorer
item.description: Threat Signal 69. JScript in Microsoft Internet Explorer allows remote attackers to execute remote code or cause a denial of service (memory corruption) via a crafted web site.

item.title: CVE-2021-21973 — VMware vCenter Server and Cloud Foundation
item.description: Threat Signal 69. VMware vCenter Server and Cloud Foundation Server contain a SSRF vulnerability due to improper validation of URLs in a vCenter Server plugin. This allows for information disclosure.

item.title: CVE-2021-36934 — Microsoft Windows
item.description: Threat Signal 69. If a Volume Shadow Copy (VSS) shadow copy of the system drive is available, users can read the SAM file which would allow any user to escalate privileges to SYSTEM level.

item.title: CVE-2021-25297 — Nagios Nagios XI
item.description: Threat Signal 69. Nagios XI contains a vulnerability which can lead to OS command injection on the Nagios XI server.

item.title: CVE-2019-0211 — Apache HTTP Server
item.description: Threat Signal 69. Apache HTTP Server, with MPM event, worker or prefork, code executing in less-privileged child processes or threads (including scripts executed by an in-process scripting interpreter) could execute code with the privileges of the parent process (usually root) by manipulating the scoreboard.

item.title: CVE-2019-0541 — Microsoft MSHTML
item.description: Threat Signal 69. Microsoft MSHTML engine contains an improper input validation vulnerability that allows for remote code execution vulnerability.

item.title: CVE-2018-2380 — SAP Customer Relationship Management (CRM)
item.description: Threat Signal 69. SAP Customer Relationship Management (CRM) contains a path traversal vulnerability that allows an attacker to exploit insufficient validation of path information provided by users.

item.title: CVE-2026-102490 — Zammad GmbH Zammad
item.description: Threat Signal 68. Zammad GmbH Zammad contains an improper privilege management vulnerability that can allow the local zammad user to escalate privileges to root. This vulnerability can be chained with CVE-2026-102489.

item.title: CVE-2026-102489 — Zammad GmbH Zammad
item.description: Threat Signal 68. Zammad GmbH Zammad contains a session fixation vulnerability that can lead to remote code execution as the zammad user. This vulnerability can be chained with CVE-2026-102490.

item.title: CVE-2025-25249 — Fortinet Multiple Products
item.description: Threat Signal 68. Fortinet FortiOS, FortiSwitchManager, and FortiSASE contain a heap-based buffer overflow vulnerability that allows an attacker to execute unauthorized code or commands via specially crafted packets.

item.title: CVE-2026-75650 — Adobe Commerce and Magento
item.description: Threat Signal 68. Adobe Commerce and Magento Open Source contain an improper neutralization of special elements used in a template engine vulnerability that could allow an attacker to execute arbitrary code.

item.title: CVE-2026-72898 — Metabase Metabase
item.description: Threat Signal 68. Metabase contains a SQL Injection vulnerability that allows an unauthenticated remote attacker to inject arbitrary SQL into the Metabase application database, which can give them administrator access to the instance. From there, the attacker could change the application configuration, steal stored credentials for the connected databases, read any data accessible through those connections, and export data.

item.title: CVE-2026-48939 — iCagenda iCagenda
item.description: Threat Signal 68. iCagenda contains an unrestricted upload of file with dangerous type vulnerability that allows the upload of arbitrary files in the file attachment feature, ultimately resulting in PHP code upload and execution.

item.title: CVE-2026-33825 — Microsoft Defender
item.description: Threat Signal 68. Microsoft Defender contains an insufficient granularity of access control vulnerability that could allow an authorized attacker to escalate privileges locally.

item.title: CVE-2020-9715 — Adobe Acrobat
item.description: Threat Signal 68. Adobe Acrobat contains a use-after-free vulnerability that allows for code execution

item.title: CVE-2026-20963 — Microsoft SharePoint
item.description: Threat Signal 68. Microsoft SharePoint contains a deserialization of untrusted data vulnerability that allows an unauthorized attacker to execute code over a network.

item.title: CVE-2025-20393 — Cisco Multiple Products
item.description: Threat Signal 68. Cisco Secure Email Gateway, Secure Email, AsyncOS Software, and Web Manager appliances contains an improper input validation vulnerability that allows threat actors to execute arbitrary commands with root privileges on the underlying operating system of an affected appliance.

item.title: CVE-2021-26828 — OpenPLC ScadaBR
item.description: Threat Signal 68. OpenPLC ScadaBR contains an unrestricted upload of file with dangerous type vulnerability that allows remote authenticated users to upload and execute arbitrary JSP files via view_edit.shtm.

item.title: CVE-2025-53690 — Sitecore Multiple Products
item.description: Threat Signal 68. Sitecore Experience Manager (XM), Experience Platform (XP), Experience Commerce (XC), and Managed Cloud contain a deserialization of untrusted data vulnerability involving the use of default machine keys. This flaw allows attackers to exploit exposed ASP.NET machine keys to achieve remote code execution.
